'''Group C''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] military formation on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Venaari]] under the overall command of [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Gaevril Daraada]]. Consisting of a single [[SV-50 Swift-Strike Speeder]] [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by two crew with a pair of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], Group C was neutralized by [[Sienn Sconn]] and [[Shandria L'hnnar]]. The pair stole the strike speeder to escape from Imperial forces.<ref name="OOAK" />
